resources.string:
macOS 14 (Sonoma) under QEMU on this phone, via OSX-KVM.
Guest is x86_64 on an aarch64 host → TCG only, NO KVM. Expect it to be VERY slow; a full install may not finish.
Flow: Debian chroot → install qemu-system-x86 → stage OSX-KVM → fetch Sonoma recovery → boot (VNC).
No Apple images are shipped; you download them on-device. Apple EULA applies.
